features.name: Growing expansions
features.description: Each expansion of the special symbol adds an extra instance to its reel, increasing ways paid.

review:
Book of Golden Sands reworks the book format on a 6x3 grid with 729 ways to win. Egyptian symbols and multiplier wilds fill the reels, and the book itself acts as both wild and scatter.

Three or more books unlock free spins, where a random special symbol is chosen. When it expands to cover a reel it also adds one extra instance of that symbol to the top of the reel, and further expansions on the same reel increase the number of ways it pays. That stacking effect is what takes the game to its stated 10,000x maximum, double the cap of a classic book slot. The RTP is 96.46%. If you find standard book games repetitive, this is a more dynamic take.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
